A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you
jump in.

More help on GitHub ↗
Can I use it from the ChatGPT website?+

This release runs on your computer, alongside Blockbench. It needs a local desktop chat with plugin execution support. Browser-only ChatGPT cannot directly connect to this local package. A hosted version is future work.

Does it create playable Minecraft items?+

It creates editable model and texture assets. A wearable bag, inventory item, working staff, or playable mob still needs the appropriate item, attachable, or behavior configuration and in-game testing. Resource export is a starting point for integration.

Can I try it without an AI account?+

Yes. Load the plugin in Blockbench and use the Bag, Staff, or Robot examples in the Create panel. You can also download and open the sample .bbmodel files above. Custom natural-language design needs a connected AI host.

What can I edit after generation?+

Every model part stays editable in Blockbench. Named recoloring is available through chat. Structural revisions through MCP currently create a new model copy; use Blockbench’s native tools for precise edits to individual parts.

Is VoxelFlow free?+

VoxelFlow’s original code is MIT licensed, and the desktop download is free. Your chosen AI host has its own account requirements and usage terms. VoxelFlow has no built-in paid AI endpoint or separate API-key requirement for its local tools.
